capabilities: List installed community plugins in a sidebar with official descriptions
Show official English descriptions with inline Chinese annotations
Edit personal notes per plugin in the sidebar
Fetch official descriptions from the community plugin registry and translate them to Simplified Chinese
Filter plugins by name, official description, or personal note
extras: Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires network access the first time descriptions are fetched and whenever translations are refreshed; requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later. Plugin interface is in Chinese.
motivation: The author built it to help users quickly understand what each installed third-party plugin is for.
problem: Obsidian provides no built-in way to review the official descriptions of already-installed community plugins or annotate them with personal notes in one place.
summary: Plugin information browser that lists installed community plugins with official descriptions, Simplified Chinese annotations, and editable personal notes.
